facts.fact: The World Bank ID4D diagnostic states that the Gambia's National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy was developed for 2023-2028 and that a validation workshop was held with stakeholders on 16-17 May 2024; it records no adopting act.
facts.system: National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028

systems.system: National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2028
systems.country_label: The Gambia's National Digital ID and Digital Transformation Strategy
systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy
systems.tiers: stated as reflecting the country's commitment to using digital technologies for development; the diagnostic separately lists finalising a National Digital ID and CRVS Strategy as a next step

stated to identify digital identity as a core foundational pillar alongside digital payments, e-government services and digital literacy; the diagnostic says it should be the primary policy mandate for the identity programme
national; Pillar 1 on governance and Pillar 4 on transforming the economy are said to align with digital ID

systems.system: Western Africa Regional Digital Integration Program (WARDIP) and Lending Operation P173287
